Subacute hematoma on placental magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
outcome: Amount of blood loss at CS
cohort: 78 consecutive patients with PP (median age, 34.5 years; interquartile range [IQR], 31-37 years) who underwent placental MRI in the third trimester.
finding: Subacute hematoma on placental MRI was associated with antenatal bleeding, emergency CS and shorter GA at delivery in patients with PP.
mod_finding: Marginal hematoma was also associated with antenatal bleeding and emergency CS.
gest_age: Median 36w3d in patients with subacute hematoma, median 37w1d in patients without
